title: Guided Mangrove Eco Tours Kayak or Paddleboard Adventure
includes: Dry Bags for your belongings available to borrow
Sun Protection - Sun Bum products available for purchase (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the serene mangrove waterways of Geiger Key on this guided eco-tour. Perfect for all ages and levels of experience. Choose between a single kayak, double kayak, or stand-up paddleboard as you glide through the lush scenery. Your knowledgeable guide will point out the hidden gems of this unique Florida Keys ecosystem, ensuring a memorable and educational experience. With safety gear, paddle instruction, bottled water, and dry bags provided, all you need to bring is your sense of adventure. Enjoy complimentary shuttle pick-up from Key West and immerse yourself in nature for two hours of tranquility.
